bb.name: Notes
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Jot a note from anywhere in bb: click Notes in the sidebar footer or press ⇧⌘J, and a Notes popover opens beside the sidebar with your notes and a composer at its bottom. Type and press ⌘↵. Type @ to link a thread, and attach screenshots or recordings by pasting, dropping or clicking 📎. Or highlight text in a reply and choose Add to notes to keep that passage with a link back to its message. The same list is a Notes card on the New thread screen. Click notes to tick them, then delete them, or choose New thread to put them in the new-thread composer as context, from any screen; on a thread page, Send to this thread puts them in that thread's draft instead. ⌘↵ and ⇧⌘↵ do the same from the list.
